mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months compresses discount rates for equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods with declining FEDFUNDS (t-test p>0.05 vs baseline).

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5% for two consecutive months, it signals a restrictive monetary policy that reduces corporate borrowing and equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 45% of triggered periods (t-test p>0.05 vs negative baseline).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates a labor market overheating without corresponding demand growth, triggering a market correction that produces negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of declining HOUST and UNRATE fails to predict negative returns in more than 55% of cases (Rank IC < 0.03).

mechanism_narrative: In periods of strong economic growth (GDPC1 quarterly growth > 1.5%), rising housing starts (HOUST) signal robust consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods meeting the trigger condition (t-test p>0.05 vs positive baseline).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) over the past 3 months indicates expanding manufacturing activity, which boosts corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods with rising INDPRO (t-test p>0.05 vs baseline).

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) falls below 3.5% for two consecutive months, it signals a tight labor market that may lead to wage inflation and central bank tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 45% of triggered periods (t-test p>0.05 vs negative baseline).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in inflation (CPIAUCSL) and stable or rising interest rates (FEDFUNDS) signals persistent inflationary pressures that prompt central bank hawkishness, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising CPIAUCSL and stable FEDFUNDS fails to predict negative returns in more than 55% of cases (Rank IC < 0.03).

mechanism_narrative: In periods of high unemployment (UNRATE > 5.0%), a decline in the unemployment rate signals improving labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods meeting the trigger condition (t-test p>0.05 vs positive baseline).
